scope.change: Require one explicit location for every Kernel scheduled weather operation and curated job-plan/runner invocation.
scope.standalone_cli: The standalone services.ingestion.weather CLI retains its existing all-active-location mode; this mode is not accepted by the Kernel scheduler contract.

limitations: This prevents the scheduled command contract from launching an all-location weather scan without an explicit location argument; it does not establish a signed worker tenant context or a worker-specific database role.
Persisted scheduled-task rows and external Prefect schedules still require separate reconciliation; no task row was read or changed.
Application-table RLS remains disabled and must remain disabled until worker identities, roles, and all data access paths are closed.
